body.p: The amendment above corrects typographic errors as noted by the Examiner in the Office Action, in claims 12 and 15.

It is believed that the application is now in condition for allowance.

required regarding this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17 or credit any overpayment to the payment enclosed herewith and/or the credit card payment instructions in EFS-Web.
